decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing numbers P_101 Rev P01, P_102 Rev P01, P_103 Rev P01, P_104 Rev P01, P_105 Rev P01, P_106 Rev P01, P_201 Rev P01, P_202 Rev P01, P_301 Rev P01, P_302 Rev P01, P_303 Rev P01, dated 4th March 2025.

The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension(s) hereby permitted shall match those specified in the design and access statement dated 4th March 2025 and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The flat roof area of the extension(s) hereby approved shall be accessed for the purpose of maintenance only and shall not be used as a terrace/balcony nor access provided over for use as amenity space at any time.</span></p>
description: Construction of a single storey wraparound extension, single storey porch extension and roof extension including raising the ridge, rear dormer and extension above two storey outrigger. Conversion of garage to habitable space, installation of three roof lights to the front, external insulation, replacement windows and doors at all elevations, replacement fencing and waste storage.
